*{box-sizing:border-box}html{font-size:calc(100vw / 128)}html,body{margin:0;background:transparent}
body{min-height:100vh;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
i,em,b{font-style:normal}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.osb-core-fields{display:none!important}
.slot{position:relative;display:grid}.slot>*{grid-area:1/1;position:relative}
[aria-hidden="true"]{visibility:hidden!important}
.isMatchPoint[style*="opacity: 1"],.isAMatchPoint[style*="opacity: 1"],.isBMatchPoint[style*="opacity: 1"]{animation:osbPulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes osbPulse{50%{filter:brightness(1.15)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.isGamePoint,.isMatchPoint,.isAGamePoint,.isBGamePoint,.isAMatchPoint,.isBMatchPoint,.isACurrentlyServing,.isBCurrentlyServing{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
body:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .isMatchStarted{opacity:0!important}

/* ---------- call panel: white rows, navy rails, violet score-call panel ---------- */
.board{
  --fc:"OSB Barlow Condensed",Arial,sans-serif;--fn:"OSB Barlow",Arial,sans-serif;
  --ink:#111633;--green:#111633;--rail:#1d2448;--mint:#d9ddf2;--yel:#ffb020;--red:#e8304f;--court:#fff;--line:#dde1ee;--vio:#6d4aff;
  --rh:5.8rem;--hh:3.8rem;--fh:3.8rem;--gw:5rem;--sw:3.8rem;--pw:6.8rem;
  position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:max-content;min-width:60rem;
  font-family:var(--fc);color:var(--ink);background:var(--court);border-radius:.5rem;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 .4rem 1.2rem #0008}
.board:has(.sn.isDoubles[style*="opacity: 1"]){--sw:6.8rem}
.stage{position:fixed;left:6.4rem;bottom:4rem}
.deck{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:stretch}
.main{position:static;flex:1 0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column}

/* header: status tab | event and round | column labels over the score columns */
.head{display:flex;align-items:stretch;height:var(--hh);background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.sslot{flex:none}
.st{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6rem;padding:0 1.2rem;white-space:nowrap}
.sslot>.st{background:var(--rail);color:var(--mint)}
.sslot>.swarm{background:#ff9f1c;color:#1d1300}
.sslot>.scur,.sslot>.sgame{background:var(--yel);color:var(--ink)}
.sslot>.sbrk{background:var(--yel);color:var(--ink)}
.sslot>.sfin{background:var(--yel);color:var(--ink)}
.lv{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:2.2rem;padding:0 .5rem;border-radius:.3rem;background:#fff;color:var(--vio);font-size:1.6rem;letter-spacing:.06em}
.ctx{flex:1 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 1.2rem;color:var(--mint);font-weight:600}
.cw{display:flex;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}
.cw>.ev,.cw>.rd{white-space:nowrap}
.cw>.rd::before{content:"\00b7";margin:0 .6rem;color:var(--yel)}
.cw>.ev:empty+.rd::before{display:none}
.rlab{flex:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--gw) var(--sw) var(--pw);align-items:center;color:var(--mint);font-size:1.6rem;letter-spacing:.05em;text-align:center}
.rlab>.lt{display:none}

/* rows */
.r{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:stretch;height:var(--rh);background:var(--court)}
.rB{border-top:.15rem solid var(--line)}
.chip{width:.7rem;flex:none;background:#2a5bd7}
.rB .chip{background:#d7263d}
.who{flex:1 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;padding:0 1.2rem 0 1.1rem}
.nm{font-size:3rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.005em}
.cards{position:relative;flex:none;width:2.4rem;height:2.6rem}
.card{position:absolute;top:.18rem;display:block;width:1.6rem;height:2.4rem;border-radius:.2rem;box-shadow:0 0 0 .12rem #0003}
.yc{left:0;background:#ffd200}
.rc{left:0;background:#e3262f}
.cards:has(>.yc[style*="opacity: 1"])>.rc{left:.8rem}
.card:not([style*="opacity: 1"]){display:none}
.cards:not(:has(>.card[style*="opacity: 1"])){visibility:hidden}
.toslot{flex:none;justify-items:start;align-items:center}
.tob{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;height:3rem;padding:0 .6rem;border-radius:.35rem;background:#ff9f1c;color:#1d1300;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}
.tob .tclock{font-family:var(--fn);font-size:1.9rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0}
.tou{display:flex;align-items:center;height:3rem;padding:0 .6rem;border-radius:.35rem;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;white-space:nowrap}
.tob:not([style*="opacity: 1"]):not(.tsz),.tou:not([style*="opacity: 1"]){visibility:hidden}

/* score columns: games | serve | points (fixed widths shared with header and footer) */
.setc{flex:none;width:var(--gw);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;background:#f3f1ff;border-left:.15rem solid var(--line)}
.sets{font-family:var(--fn);font-size:3.3rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--vio);line-height:1}
.sv{flex:none;width:var(--sw);place-items:center}
.srv{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem}
.pball{display:block;width:2.4rem;height:2.4rem;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 34%,#0005 0 8%,transparent 9%),radial-gradient(circle at 64% 30%,#0005 0 8%,transparent 9%),radial-gradient(circle at 52% 64%,#0005 0 8%,transparent 9%),radial-gradient(circle at 24% 72%,#0004 0 6%,transparent 7%),radial-gradient(circle at 78% 70%,#0004 0 6%,transparent 7%),radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%,#fbffb4,#d8f22c 60%,#a6c214);box-shadow:0 0 0 .15rem #0b1a12}
.sn{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:2.6rem;height:2.6rem;padding:0 .4rem;border-radius:.35rem;background:var(--green);color:var(--yel);font-family:var(--fn);font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.sn>i{grid-area:1/1}
.sn:has(>.isSecondServer[style*="opacity: 1"])>.one,.cn:has(>.isSecondServer[style*="opacity: 1"])>.one{opacity:0}
.pts{flex:none;width:var(--pw);position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--green);color:#fff}
.rB .pts{border-top:.15rem solid #2b3256}
.pts>*{grid-area:1/1}
.spt{align-self:stretch;justify-self:stretch;display:block}
.sgp{background:var(--yel)}
.smp{background:var(--red)}
.pv{position:relative;font-family:var(--fn);font-size:4rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.pts:has(>.sgp[style*="opacity: 1"])>.pv{color:var(--ink)}
.pts:has(>.smp[style*="opacity: 1"])>.pv{color:#fff}
.pts:has(>.smp[style*="opacity: 1"])>.sgp{opacity:0!important}

/* footer: call + game ledger | match format under the score columns */
.foot{display:flex;align-items:stretch;height:var(--fh);background:#f1f2f8;border-top:.15rem solid var(--line)}
.fl{flex:1 0 auto;display:grid;align-items:center;padding:0 1.2rem 0 1.8rem}
.fl>*{grid-area:1/1}
.flive,.fsz{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.2rem}
.cl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#3b4266}
.call{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.15rem;font-family:var(--fn);font-size:2.2rem;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--ink)}
.call .ca{order:1}.call .d1{order:2}.call .cb{order:3}.call .dbl{order:4;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.board:has(.isBCurrentlyServing[style*="opacity: 1"]) .call .ca{order:3}
.board:has(.isBCurrentlyServing[style*="opacity: 1"]) .call .cb{order:1}
.call .dbl:not([style*="opacity: 1"]){display:none}
.d1,.d2{padding:0 .1rem}
.cn{position:relative;display:inline-grid}.cn>i{grid-area:1/1}
.hist{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}
.hc{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.3rem}
.hc:not([style*="opacity: 1"]){display:none}
.fsz .hc{display:flex}
.hl{font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#3b4266;margin-right:.2rem}
.hv{position:relative;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:3rem;height:2.6rem;padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:.3rem;background:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .12rem #c9cee3}
.hv>*{grid-area:1/1}
.hv>.w{align-self:stretch;justify-self:stretch;border-radius:.3rem;background:var(--vio)}
.hv>.num{position:relative;font-family:var(--fn);font-size:1.9rem;font-weight:700;color:#3b4266}
.hv:has(>.w[style*="opacity: 1"])>.num{color:#fff}
.rfoot{flex:none;width:calc(var(--gw) + var(--sw) + var(--pw));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#e4e7f3;color:#3b4266;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}

/* game point / match point: one label attached to the side that holds it (A above its score columns, B below) */
.pt{justify-content:center;padding:0 .4rem;font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.03em}
.pt.gp{background:var(--yel);color:var(--ink)}
.pt.mp{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.pt:not([style*="opacity: 1"]){visibility:hidden}
.pslot:has(>.mp[style*="opacity: 1"])>.gp{opacity:0!important}

/* between games and final: the score columns merge into one GAMES column (width unchanged) */
.board:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rA .setc,.board:has(.isBWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rB .setc{background:var(--vio)}

/* team tie strip (structural) */
.tie{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;height:4rem;padding:0 1.2rem;background:var(--rail);color:#fff;font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;border-bottom:.2rem solid var(--yel)}
.tie:has(>.teamAName[style*="display: none"]){display:none}
.tlogo{display:block;flex:none;width:2.8rem;height:2.8rem;object-fit:contain}
.tlogo:not([src]),.tlogo[src=""]{visibility:hidden}
.tchip{display:block;flex:none;width:.6rem;height:2.4rem}
.tname{flex:1 0 auto;white-space:nowrap}
.tname.tb{text-align:right}
.tsc{display:flex;align-items:center;flex:none;font-family:var(--fn);font-size:2.4rem;color:var(--yel)}
.tdash{color:var(--mint);padding:0 .3rem}
.board:has(.combinedAName:empty):has(.combinedBName:empty)>:not(.tie){display:none!important}
.board:has(.combinedAName:empty):has(.combinedBName:empty)>.tie{height:5rem;font-size:2.2rem;border-bottom:0}
.board:has(.combinedAName:empty):has(.combinedBName:empty) .tsc{font-size:3rem;padding:0 1rem}

.sslot>.sbrk,.sslot>.sgame,.sslot>.sfmt,.sslot>.sfin{gap:0}
.sslot>.scur{gap:.6rem}
.sn:not([style*="opacity: 1"]){display:none}

/* score-call panel: status tab on top, the call (or the result) below; fixed width in every state */
.panel{flex:none;width:20rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--green);color:#fff;border-left:.6rem solid var(--vio)}
.panel>.sslot{height:var(--hh);font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.sslot>.st{background:var(--rail);color:var(--mint)}
.sslot>.scur,.sslot>.sgame,.sslot>.sbrk,.sslot>.sfin{background:var(--vio);color:#fff}
.sslot>.swarm{background:var(--yel);color:var(--ink)}
.hero{flex:1;display:grid;place-items:center}
.hero>*{grid-area:1/1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.6rem}
.hl2{font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#c3c9e6}
.hero .call{font-size:5.6rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1}
.hero .call .cn{font-size:4rem}
.big{font-size:3rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.03em;line-height:1}
.ctx{padding-left:1.8rem}
:has(>.isMatchPoint[style*="opacity: 1"])>.isGamePoint,:has(>.isMatchPoint[style*="opacity:1"])>.isGamePoint,:has(>.isAMatchPoint[style*="opacity: 1"])>.isAGamePoint,:has(>.isBMatchPoint[style*="opacity: 1"])>.isBGamePoint{opacity:0!important}

/* functional rules: bound flags are shown only by their own data; the point values stay visible (dimmed) in every state */
.board:has(.isMatchStarted[style*="opacity: 1"]) .swarm,.board:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .swarm{opacity:0!important}
.board:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rA .sets,.board:has(.isBWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rB .sets{color:#fff}

.flive .hc:not([style*="display: none"]){display:flex!important}
/* ---- round 7 ---- */
/* badges: fixed columns right of the name area, aligned between the rows whatever the name length or card presence */
.who>.nm{flex:1 0 auto}
/* point banner: the shared GAME POINT / MATCH POINT pair lives in the header's context cell (never over the column headers) */
.ctx{display:grid!important;align-items:stretch;padding:0!important}
.ctx>*{grid-area:1/1}
.ctx>.cw{align-self:center;padding:0 1.2rem}
.pslot{position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;display:grid!important;z-index:4}
.pslot>.pt{position:relative!important;inset:auto!important;top:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;height:auto!important;grid-area:1/1;align-self:stretch}
.psz{visibility:hidden}
/* co-location: the game in play draws once (its ledger cell sits under the live points); at final the last game sits under the points, labelled LAST GAME */
.pts{z-index:2}
.panel{position:relative;z-index:3}

/* the game in play shows only as the live points; the history lists completed games */

.board:has(.isGame2Current[style*="opacity: 1"]) :is(.hist,.led,.lled)>.h2{display:none!important}

.board:has(.isGame5Current[style*="opacity: 1"]) :is(.hist,.led,.lled)>.h5{display:none!important}

.board:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .pv{display:none}
.board:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rlab>:is(.lsv,.lp){visibility:hidden}

.pts>.win:not([style*="opacity: 1"]){visibility:hidden}

.board:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .toslot{visibility:visible}
.pts>.win{background:var(--vio);color:#fff}
/* panel: the format before play, the score call in play, UP NEXT between games, the result at final */

.board:has(.isInBetweenGames[style*="opacity: 1"]):not(:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"])) .hero>.hbrk{display:flex!important}
.big.res{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;font-family:var(--fn);font-size:5rem}
.hpre .big{font-size:3.2rem}
.hbrk .big{font-size:3.6rem}
/* GAMES numerals: navy on lavender for contrast */
.sets{color:var(--ink)!important}
.board:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rA .sets,.board:has(.isBWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rB .sets{color:#fff!important}
.rfoot .fmt{font-size:1.8rem}
/* T/O USED gives way to the running timeout (contract: used marker hidden while a timeout runs) */
.toslot:has(>.tob[style*="opacity: 1"]:not(.tsz))>.tou:not(.tsz){display:none!important}

/* ---- round 9 ---- */
/* point tag: its own place in the status tab (a state), never over the event line or the column labels */
.sslot>.pslot{grid-area:1/1;position:relative!important;display:grid!important;align-self:stretch;justify-self:stretch;z-index:4;margin:0!important}
.sslot>.pslot>.pt{grid-area:1/1;align-self:stretch;justify-self:stretch;padding:0 .9rem}
.ctx{display:flex!important;align-items:center;padding:0 1.2rem!important}
/* final: one result cell spanning both rows in the points column (the winner's WIN, no empty loser cell) */
.board:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .pts{border-top:0!important}
.board:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rA .pts{height:calc(200% + .15rem);align-self:flex-start;z-index:3}
.board:has(.isBWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rB .pts{height:calc(200% + .15rem);margin-top:calc(-1 * (var(--rh) + .15rem));align-self:flex-start;z-index:3}
.board:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .pts>.win{font-size:2rem;height:3.6rem}
/* footer: the format and the finished games on the left, the score call under the score columns */
.rfoot{display:grid!important;place-items:center}
.rfoot>*{grid-area:1/1}
.clsz{visibility:hidden}
.fmt{font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.fl .fmt,.flive .fmt,.fsz .fmt{padding-right:1.4rem;margin-right:.2rem;border-right:.15rem solid currentColor}
.fl .fmt{color:#3b4266}
/* panel: the score call from the first serve (0-0 before it), UP NEXT between games, the result at final */
.board:not(:has(.isMatchStarted[style*="opacity: 1"])):not(:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"])) .hero>.hcall{display:flex!important}
.board:not(:has(.isMatchStarted[style*="opacity: 1"])) .hero>.hpre{display:none!important}
.board:not(:has(.isMatchStarted[style*="opacity: 1"])) .hero .call{color:#c3c9e6}
/* row B divider drawn as a line, so the row itself paints no box (the final result cell spans both rows) */
.rB{background:transparent!important;border-top:0!important}
.rB::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-.15rem;height:.15rem;background:var(--line);z-index:1}
.board:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rA .pts{z-index:3}
/* the WIN mark sits level with the winner row inside the one result cell */
.board:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rA .pts>.win{align-self:start;margin-top:calc((var(--rh) - 3.6rem) / 2)}
.board:has(.isBWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .rB .pts>.win{align-self:end;margin-bottom:calc((var(--rh) - 3.6rem) / 2)}
